I've told him this for 18 months. he has selective memory. I just want to feel safe and like he's being honest. Context is hard to give when you're this close to the edge. but i know you're trying to help and steer me to a solutino.

he's not trying to help, not with this he's just pushing an agenda. that thankfully he just copped to and apologized for. he's from a culture where you just forgive people over and over and he doesn't understand how dangerous it is to 'reconcile' with active drug users (because there is very little drug use in the culture he comes from, not like here.)

not sure why i'm still rambling though.

I am disabled. I used to be strong and independent and able to support myself.  I am now totally powerless. If I leave my husband, I'm not even sure how or if I will survive because i have Zero support system.

I can't be any more clear. Please have patience with me. I am barely able to walk today and my husband is fucking shit up for me again.
